verdict.rationale: Bland's SIP integration docs say it supports inbound and outbound SIP: you can point calls from your own carrier or PBX at Bland, or have Bland place calls through your SIP provider (bland-docs-17). It also documents number porting (bland-docs-16) and connecting your own Twilio account to bring existing numbers (bland-docs-3), which covers the core of avoiding locked-in telephony. Missing for 10: any evidence of Telnyx number import, clarity on whether SIP is limited to enterprise plans (it sits under enterprise-features), SIP configuration detail (auth, codecs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
